title: Painter Song
original_lyrics:
[verse]
TUNE DOWN 3 HALF STEPS
(#5)
If I were painter
I would paint my reverie
If that's the only way for you to be with me
(#5)
We' be there together
Just like we used to be
Underneath the swirling skies for all to see
And I'm dreaming of place
Where I could see your face
And - I - think - my - brush - would - take - me - there

[bridge]
(#5)
If I were painter
And could paint memory
I' climb inside the swirling skies to be with you
I' climb inside the skies to be with you
And I'm dreaming of place
Where I could see your face
And - I - think - my - brush - would - take - me - there

[bridge]
(#5)
If I were painter
And could paint memory
I' climb inside the swirling skies to be with you
I' climb inside the skies to be with you
